notes.title: The Countdown Til Release!
notes.content:
Fellow Steamers,

It is with great pleasure that Astoria: The Holders of Power Saga, has finally made its way onto the Store Page on Steam.  This has been a four year labor of love!  Over these next two weeks, myself, playtesters, and Kickstarter Backers and testers will be finalizing our runs through the game so that in August when ATHOPS finally gets released, it is as polished as possible.  I really hope you give this game a try, and until then, happy gaming!

- Golden Unicorn Gaming
